description:
Herbert and Lansdowne estate agents present an excellent opportunity to acquire a well-located 2-bedroom bungalow situated in a small, quiet and secure gated development in the heart of Dún Laoghaire.
Offering comfortable single-level accommodation the property combines a welcoming interior with an enviable location, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a low maintenance home in one of South Dublin's most sought after coastal locations.
The accommodation comprises two well-proportioned bedrooms, a modern bathroom and a bright open plan kitchen and living area.  The open plan layout create a generous sense of space, with the kitchen flowing naturally into the living room- an ideal setting for both relaxed everyday living and entertaining.
Located in a small, peaceful gated development, the property would make an ideal home for first-time buyers, downsizers or those seeking a low-maintenance property in a sought-after South Dublin location. 
The location is a particular highlight. Dún Laoghaire Main Street is just a short walk away, offering an excellent selection of cafes, restaurants, boutiques and everyday amenities. The Seafront, pier and Dún Laoghaire baths are also within easy reach, providing wonderful opportunities for coastal walks and enjoying the area's unique seaside atmosphere. The town also hosts regular thriving weekend markets and enjoys and excellent atmosphere. Transports links are excellent with DART and Dublin bus providing convenient access to Dublin City Centre and beyond.

Coving, recessed lighting, feature gas fireplace with a wrought iron insert and polished hearth, curtains, wooden floors.

Wall lights, fitted wardrobes, blind, wooden floor.
